name: k2so-rats-fixes
title: K2SO Rat's Fixes
author: deadrat22
description:
A stack-audit bugfix collection for Krastorio 2 + Space Age (K2SO): Krastorio2-spaced-out, its tweaks mod, nulls-k2so-tweaks and the xy fork playing together.

The headline fix: crafted biomass no longer inherits parent spoilage, so the recursive 2 -> 5 biomass loop in the bioprocessing facility keeps itself fresh instead of rotting the whole bio pipeline (and military science) at once. Biomass from egg crushing and the spoilage recipe, fertilizer and greenhouse-grown Gleba crops spawn fresh too.

Also fixed: asteroids keep their kr-radioactive immunity (which nulls-k2so-tweaks' resistance standardization silently erased; configurable, auto drops to 50% with eRisel-k2-arsenal); the K2 intergalactic transceiver can be built on Cerys again; labs render correctly with more than 24 science packs; maraxsis reads the intended sand item; two-item spoil cycles from item migrations are broken; the advanced centrifuge consumes the atan-atom-forge xy computed but never used.

Every fix is verified by a headless e2e suite against the real mod stack, and ready-to-apply upstream patches for the original mods are bundled. Without the K2SO stack installed this mod does nothing.
